Objective: Develop a robust vehicle counting application optimized for the NVIDIA Jetson Nano. The application should accurately count cars passing through multiple cameras using RTSP live streams.

Key Requirements:

Modular Design:
The software should have a configurable region of interest (ROI). This will allow customization of the tracking area for different camera setups.
The system should support settings for either two-way or single direction vehicle detection, selectable per camera.
Multi-Camera Support:
The application must handle live feeds from at least three cameras simultaneously without frame skipping.
Ensure seamless capturing, detecting, and tracking across all cameras, maintaining high accuracy and performance.
Error Handling:
Implement robust error handling to ensure the application runs continuously without crashes.
Auto-recovery features should be included to handle and log stream interruptions or other common errors.
RTSP Streaming Compatibility:
Must support RTSP for fetching live video feeds directly from IP cameras.
Compatibility with different camera manufacturers and models should be considered.
Performance Requirements:
The system should be optimized for low latency and high throughput on the Jetson Nano platform.
Efficient use of the hardware’s capabilities to prevent lag and ensure real-time processing.
Deliverables:

Fully functional vehicle counting software that meets the above specifications.
Source code with detailed comments and documentation.
A user guide describing how to set up and configure the application for different environments and cameras.
Additional Notes:

Developers bidding on this project should have experience with computer vision, Python programming, and familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
Previous work on similar real-time image processing projects will be considered a strong advantage.
This project aims to create a dependable and efficient vehicle counting solution tailored for environments requiring multiple camera setups, such as parking lots and traffic monitoring stations.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-25" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Vehicle counting on Jetson nano from IP camera using RTSP for 3 cameras"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Step 2: From remaining stocks meeting filtered results from Step 1 scan most current up to previous 7 earnings releases and calculate to get average eps growth percentage gain, revenue growth percentage gain and sales growth percentage gain as well as stock price appreciation growth from most current earnings release date to a year back from most current earnings release date.

Step 5: Repeat steps 1, 2 and 3 for each stock when it releases an new earnings report to update its cumulative growth score value and reallocate USD weighting depending on new score from update.

Vehicle Re-identification

Vehicle re-identification (Re-ID) is a computer vision task that aims to match vehicle images captured from non-overlapping camera views. The goal is to identify the same vehicle instance across multiple camera views, which can be useful for traffic management and law enforcement applications.
The purpose of this coursework is to gain real-world development experience in the design, training, and evaluation of a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) for vehicle Re-ID. This will be achieved through the Google Colab with PyTorch as the framework.

The product involves a user selecting and locking a camera position per room to avoid rotation issues which have shown too many discrepancies in tests. The user selects furniture and background images, and these selections are saved and used for generating future images.

Image Generation and Upscaling:

Images of selected furniture and backgrounds are layered together and upscaled. A high-quality upscaler is used that enhances photorealism by improving shadows and lighting integration.

Performance and Speed Concerns:

Current models take too long (up to 45 seconds) to generate images, affecting user experience. The aim is to reduce this to potentially under 10 seconds while maintaining quality.

Demonstration and Technical Exploration:

A live demo will be provided to showcase the product's current capabilities and the user interface. Discussions included technical details on image processing, the use of machine learning models, and the handling of furniture and background images.

Challenges and Solutions:

The team expressed a need to explore faster model options or hardware solutions to improve response times. Possible migration from cloud services like Hugging Face to dedicated hardware was discussed to achieve better control and performance.

Future Plans:

Plans include further experimentation with different models and setups to find the most efficient and cost-effective solution. The team also plans to keep refining the product based on upcoming technical evaluations and feedback.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-42" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "We are looking for Machine Learning solution architecture"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Seeking Experienced Full-stack Developer Specializing in Large Language Models (LLM)

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Full-stack Developer who specializes in developing and implementing Large Language Models (LLMs) to join our dynamic team. This project involves working on innovative applications of LLMs to enhance our product offerings and improve user experiences. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, as well as specific experience working with AI models, particularly those related to natural language processing.

**Responsibilities:**

- Design and develop robust front-end interfaces that provide users with intuitive access to our LLM's capabilities.
- Build and maintain scalable back-end services that can handle the demands of processing large datasets with LLMs.
- Integrate LLM functionalities into existing platforms, ensuring seamless operation and user interaction.
- Work closely with data scientists and AI specialists to implement and refine models based on project needs.
- Monitor, test, and continuously optimize the performance of the applications.
- Ensure data privacy and security standards are upheld throughout all stages of development.

**Requirements:**

- Proven experience as a full-stack developer with a portfolio that includes work with AI or machine learning technologies.
- Strong knowledge of front-end technologies such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and frameworks like React or Angular.
- Proficient in back-end programming languages like Python, Node.js, or Ruby.
- Experience with AI and machine learning libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and familiarity with natural language processing techniques.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience with deploying AI models in production environments.
- Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and APIs.
- Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Contributions to open-source projects or published papers in relevant fields.

**What We Offer:**

- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely.
- Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
- A collaborative and innovative work environment.

**How to Apply:**

Please submit your resume, a cover letter, and links to any relevant projects or code repositories. We look forward to learning how your skills and experiences will contribute to our team's success!

Project Description:
PhenomAI is designed to assist therapists in managing client care more effectively by bridging the gap between phenomenological methodologies and the structured documentation requirements mandated by insurance providers. This AI-enhanced clinical therapy management system will help therapists track treatment plans, goals, objectives, and transform rich, detailed clinical notes into standardized formats such as DAP, SOAP, or SIRP, ensuring both compliance and continuity in patient care.

Key Project Phases:

Phase 1: CLI Python Script Development

Develop a command-line interface (CLI) Python script as a proof of concept to manage basic client data and automate the translation of phenomenological notes to insurance-compliant formats.
Implement initial data protection mechanisms to ensure client privacy and security.
Phase 2: Intranet Web Application

Convert the CLI into a simple, user-friendly web application for use within the organization's intranet, enhancing accessibility and ease of use for therapists.
Incorporate basic security measures to comply with HIPAA regulations and ensure data integrity.
Phase 3: External Web Application Deployment (Postponed/Reduced Scope)

Depending on the outcomes and budget availability from earlier phases, consider expanding the application to an external server with enhanced security and authentication features, making it accessible online for broader usage.
Project Focus:
This system aims to streamline the documentation process while maintaining the existential-humanistic integrity of the therapeutic approach. It will facilitate easier management of client information, allowing therapists to focus more on client care and less on administrative tasks.

Budget is currently for the entire project, but Phase 1 and 2 are the most pressing. Phase 3 could be another project later.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-48" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "ChatBot for Therapists - Small Group Practice"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

The successful candidate will be tasked with enhancing our trading models to optimize capital allocation and manage risk in a financial trading system that operates across multiple asset classes.

Responsibilities:

Design and implement DDQN models to optimize trade execution and capital allocation based on real-time market data.
Integrate HHMM to predict market regimes and capture the dynamics of the order book for enhanced trading strategies.
Develop algorithms for real-time volatility assessment to dynamically adjust trading strategies based on market conditions.
Analyze liquidity data to minimize market impact and optimize the timing and size of trades.
Work collaboratively with data scientists and financial analysts to incorporate advanced quantitative techniques into our trading models.
Conduct extensive backtesting and simulation with forward-testing to validate the effectiveness of the trading strategies under various market scenarios.

Recruit Remote Research Analysts
Posted 1 hour ago
Worldwide
Overview:
We are looking for talented Remote Research Analysts to join our team on Upwork. As a Remote Research Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting primary research, analyzing data, and drafting report sections for various projects. The ideal candidate will have strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

Responsibilities:

Conduct Research: Conduct primary research using a variety of sources, including online databases, academic journals, and industry reports, to gather relevant information on assigned topics.

Data Analysis: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to extract key insights, trends, and patterns relevant to the project objectives.

Draft Report Sections: Prepare well-written and structured report sections based on research findings and analysis, ensuring clarity, coherence, and accuracy.

Collaborate: Collaborate with the Operations Coordinator and Project Manager to understand project requirements, provide updates on progress, and incorporate feedback into deliverables.

Quality Assurance: Review own work and the work of peers to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to project guidelines and standards.

Adaptability: Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to work on projects spanning various industries and subject areas, adjusting research methodologies and approaches as needed.

Time Management: Manage workload effectively to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality work within agreed-upon timelines.

Continuous Learning: Stay updated on industry trends, research methodologies, and best practices to enhance skills and capabilities as a research analyst.

Educational Background:
Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience Requirements:
At least 1 year of experience in a research, data analysis, or a related role. New graduates with relevant project or internship experience may also be considered.

Technical Skills:
Basic proficiency with at least one data analysis tool (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets). Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R is a plus but not required.
Understanding of AI concepts and trends through coursework, projects, or self-study.

Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills:
Detail-oriented with a curiosity for learning and improving in the field of AI and technology research. Capable of simple data interpretation and trend analysis to support research findings.

Time Management and Organization Skills:
Ability to manage personal workflow and deadlines, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

Language Proficiency:
Proficient English for reading research materials and writing reports. Good writing skills capable of documenting research findings clearly. Ability to communicate effectively in team settings.

Job Description:
We seek an experienced Senior NLP Engineer / Large Language Model Architect to lead the development and optimization of our NLP projects. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in refining our large language models, particularly focusing on areas such as pharmaceutical SOPs and research contexts. This role requires a deep understanding of NLP principles, practical experience in deploying large-scale models, and a problem-solving mindset geared towards delivering high-quality, efficient solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and refine large language models to meet specific project requirements, ensuring high quality and efficiency.
Lead the transition and optimization of NLP models from platforms like Solr and Elasticsearch to Sinequa and Amazon SageMaker.
Develop and implement strategies for prompt engineering, model refinement, and trainingpipelines to enhance model performance.
Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to understand project needs, providing expert guidance and NLP architectural advice.
Manage the integration of knowledge graphs into NLP models to improve contextual understanding and output relevance.
Evaluate and utilize state-of-the-art embedding vectors and encoding methods to ensure optimal model performance.
Oversee the concept extraction and entity recognition processes, ensuring integration with existing knowledge graphs and data pipelines.
Guide the team in the expansion and refinement of taxonomies using large language models, followed by human review for tagging accuracy.
Drive the adoption of best practices in NLP model development, deployment, and maintenance, staying abreast of the latest industry trends and research.
Required Skills and Experience:
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Linguistics, or a related field.
Extensive experience in NLP, with a strong portfolio of projects involving large language models.
Proficiency in using platforms such as Hugging Face, Sinequa, and Amazon SageMaker for model deployment and refinement.
Solid understanding of model training, tuning, and refinement techniques, with proven success in applying these to large-scale projects.
Experience with knowledge graphs, entity recognition, and concept extraction technologies.
Strong coding skills in relevant programming languages (e.g., Python) and familiarity with NLP libraries and frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and a commitment to high-quality outcomes.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Desirable Attributes:
Experience in the pharmaceutical or research sectors, with an understanding of SOPs and compliance requirements.
A pragmatic approach to project management, avoiding "magical" solutions and focusing on tangible results.
The flexibility to adapt to changing project needs and the ability to guide teams through technical challenges.
A team player attitude, with experience working in or leading multidisciplinary teams.

Job Overview:
Additive Flow, a Nano Dimension Division seeks a talent and forward-thinking specialist to develop a revolutionary automated deployment framework. This project focuses on creating a tool that simplifies the integration of ML surrogate models into various applications. These surrogates will act as efficient replacement for computationally expensive components and unknown relationships, significantly boosting overall application performance. The framework will leverage innovative techniques like Neural Networks (NNs) to learn complex relationships within data. The successful development of this framework will empower developers across diverse fields to seamlessly integrate ML models and unlock performance gains in their applications.

Functionalities:
1)	Automated Workflow: Provide a step-by-step process for integrating ML surrogates into existing applications.
2)	Data Preprocessing and Feature Engineering: Automated techniques to prepare and extract relevant features from application data suitable for ML model training.
3)	Hyperparameter Optimisation: Implement algorithms to automatically tune the hyperparameters of the chosen ML model for optimal performance.
4)	Surrogate Model Selection and Training: Employ a suite of ML algorithms and facilitate their training on prepared data, enabling selection of the most suitable surrogate for the specific application.
5)	Performance Evaluation and Error Estimation: Integrate methods to assess the accuracy and reliability of the surrogate model, ensuring it meets user-defined performance requirements.
6)	Seamless Integration: Design the framework to integrate seamlessly with existing application architectures, minimizing disruption to development workflows.
7)	API: Expose the main functionalities of loading and access data information through a standalone C++ API.

Technical Specifications:
1)	Programming Languages: C++ / C# / HLSL
2)	Machine Learning Libraries: TensorFlow, or similar frameworks for model development and training.
3)	Scalability and Containerization
4)	Application Programming Interface (API): Design an intuitive API for developers to interact with the framework and integrate surrogates into their applications

Inputs
During the project, the following resources will be provided:
1)	Relationship data

Deliverables
At the conclusion of the project, the following deliverables are expected:
1)	Robust Framework: A user-friendly, well-documented framework for deploying ML surrogates in various applications.
2)	Complete Documentation: Clear and detailed documentation outlining framework functionalities, usage instructions, and best practices.
3)	Sample Implementations: Demonstrations showcasing the framework's effectiveness on applications from different domains.

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Design and develop an automated workflow for surrogate integration.
•	Implement feature engineering techniques for diverse applications.
•	Develop NN models with constraint-aware training methods.
•	Integrate the framework with popular environments.
•	Document the framework and provide user tutorials.
•	Demonstrate the framework's effectiveness through sample implementations.
•	Implement robust error handling and data validation routines.
•	Document the project comprehensively, including the model, user guide, and validation results.
•	Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise during the development process.
•	Refine and optimise the algorithm to improve its performance.
•	Implement rigorous testing methodologies to ensure reliability and accuracy of the algorithm.

Qualification:
•	A bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

Must-Have Skills:
•	Experience in Machine Learning and scientific computing concepts.
•	Proficiency in C++ popular ML libraries.
•	Understanding of data preprocessing and feature engineering techniques.
•	Experience with hyperparameter optimization methodologies.
•	Excellent software development skills and experience with best practices.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Nice-to-Have Skills:
•	PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

Company Culture:
Additive Flow is all about making innovative software in a way that is good for the world. We value fresh ideas, taking care of the planet, being honest, focusing on our customers, doing our best, working together, helping each other grow, and welcoming different viewpoints. We are on a mission to make technology that does not just make money but also makes the world a better place.

Note:
 This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities and requirements of the position. https://github.com/magicleap/SuperGluePretrainedNetwork

Problem Statement:
Originally super glue is trained on single image. I want to train the super glue on image pairs. For instance a pair of same scene, one in  IR image and other in RGB image. I need a loss function for this.
Dateset
TNO dataset is used for registered image pairs.
Methadology Work Flow:
1. We have a dataloader, that reads pairs of it and RGB image pairs.
2. Then that dataloader, applies superpoint with official weights on both images individually.
3. Super glue is applied on the output of superpoints and is referred by ground_superglue (threshold is set to minimum(0.,/0.3) for maximum number of machtes)
4. return directory of dataloader is attached as dataloader_result image
5. Training: Now, a superglue model referred as train_superglue with official weights(outdoor) and high threshold(0.9) is applies to output of dataloader.
6. output of step 5 is optimized against ground truths generated in dataloader.

Loss Function is needed for this optimization in step 6.

Files and images are attached. kindly go through them before bidding.

Whole project files and dataset can be provided if required.

references:
ground_vs_predict is for data shape and data type of ground truth and predicted values.
structures show the project structure for correct paths and names.

Also inform which loss function are you gonna use while bidding.

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">30+ hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 330px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-119" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Looking to build a SaaS application aimed at helping SDR's fine-tune their pitch, rebuttals, and any actions required to help book meetings and achieve quota consistently.

This app should be able to integrate into any CRM or dialer like SalesLoft.

It should be able to listen to the SDR's calls and identify what is working based on what it hears. Due to US laws, we aren't always able to listen to the other side of conversations so this is mainly focused on the SDR's actions.

I want the AI to be able to identify good conversations from bad, and put together scripts and responses that are working best. I would also like it to identify the speed that one is speaking and how that effects a call.

I would like a dashboard that summarizes a single SDR's cold calls, and show what worked to book the meeting. This means what pitches worked, what didn't. It should then highlight the important pieces of the pitch and offer suggestions on how to improve it.

There should also be a feature to look at more than one SDR's calls and analyze what is working for the team.

It should be able to take into account past interactions logged in the CRM by the company as well.

I would also like to offer the option to learn upon previous calls if they are uploaded so that the app can provide immediate results.

Other customizable features I would like:
- deeper analytics (identifying what pitches work for what companies or roles)
- Identifying pitches against priority scores (very common in SaaS sales) </span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-119" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "AI SaaS project aimed at helping sales teams"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Less than 30 hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 572px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-120" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">
We are seeking an experienced AI developer to create a solution for generating personalized eye jewelry based on customer-submitted images. The goal is to develop an AI system that can take an image of a customer's eye, reconstruct it using generative AI techniques, and prepare it for integration into our jewelry production process.

Project Scope:

Develop an image preprocessing pipeline to detect, crop, and enhance the eye region from customer-submitted images.
Train a generative AI model (e.g., GAN) on a dataset of high-quality eye images to enable realistic eye reconstruction.
Implement a system to feed the preprocessed eye images into the trained model and generate high-quality, circular eye images suitable for printing and insertion into jewelry pendants.
Integrate the AI solution into our existing jewelry production workflow.

Required Skills and Experience:

Strong expertise in AI development, particularly in computer vision and generative models like GANs.
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and Keras.
Experience with image preprocessing techniques and libraries like OpenCV.
Knowledge of cloud AI platforms (e.g., Google Cloud AI Platform, AWS, or Azure) is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with our team.

Deliverables:

A fully functional AI system that can process customer-submitted eye images and generate high-quality, printable eye reconstructions.
Detailed documentation of the developed solution, including code, model architectures, and usage instructions.
Integration of the AI solution into our existing jewelry production pipeline.
Training and support for our team to effectively utilize the AI system.
Timeline:
As part of your proposal, please provide a realistic timeline for completing this project, taking into account the project scope and your availability. Include milestones and estimated completion dates for each phase of the project.

Budget:
Please submit a detailed price proposal for completing this project, itemizing the costs for each phase of development, as well as any additional expenses or fees. We are open to discussing the budget based on the value and feasibility of your proposal.

If you have the required skills and experience, and are passionate about applying AI to create personalized jewelry, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your proposal, including your expertise, proposed approach, timeline, budget, and any relevant examples of your work.

We look forward to collaborating with you to bring this exciting project to life!</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-120" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "AI Developer for Personalized Jewelry Generation"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

One of our bottlenecks is taking our raw data and converting it into the best video clips or photos, applying some basic edits to them, merging HDR images, and then having them come out the other end to our standards.

There would be two aspects:

1) Photo Selection, HDR Merging, Editing, and Renaming plus exporting in different sizes and formats
2) Video Clip Selection (bad clips from good clips), Stabilizing, Color Correcting, Improving Audio, Renaming, and Exporting Clips

We are already preparing to train this AI right now. For example, we'll fly our drone and might be recording video clips while we get the drone calibrated, so some clips are shaky, jerky, and 'bad'. Then we'll fly the drone in a nice, smooth, planned shot and that will be a good clip. So we already have multiple hours of footage where we have the RAW clips in one folder, the before video footage, and then we have the after clips where we cut out all of the 'bad' clips and then we color correct and export the 'good clips'. The hope is to create a project scope with an AI Machine learning expert (you) to help us know what exactly we need to do to create an AI Software that can be taught, with us giving it hours of footage to train from that are 'good shots' and 'bad shots' so that eventually we could just drop in a video clip, and it has learned what is bad and good, so it just cuts out all the bad clips, keeps the good clips, stabilizes them and color corrects them and then we are able to move forward with our business much faster.

I'd like to be able to do a similar service with photo editing. We have two types of editing we need a software/machine learning AI to help with for this project. One type is when we capture a darker photo, a properly exposed middle photo, and a brighter photo - then we merge those images together using software such as 'Photomatix' or 'Aurora HDR' which blends the best lighting conditions from each of the photos. The darker photo you can see through windows for example, but any shadows inside the building are almost black, but in the really bright photo, you can see the color and details in the shadow areas, but the window is blown out and bright white. But by merging the photos, you can see outside the window and into the shadow area.

So creating a HDR merging software similar to these softwares is an eventual project we will need help with, but in the meantime we can continue using these softwares, but the second aspect of the photo editing AI machine learning I want help with is having raw unedited photos go into it, and then it spits out perfectly edited and color balanced images on the back end.

We already have thousands of photo examples prepared, where we have the before images and then the edited after images that have the edits, color, and feel that we want.

I need help to understand the project scope of what is the cost, the process step by step, and the vehicles for finding, integrating, and training AI machine learning so that by the end of this process we can drop in any photos or any video clips and it will follow the training we have given it to quickly process and export great video clips and photos edited to our standards that were trained to be matched.

If you end up being an excellent fit for our team, this could turn into a job helping us develop the AI - but right now I'm strictly looking for someone to help me develop the project scope. Preferably someone who has done something like this before and fully understands the process.

I look forward to hearing from you, please let me know previous projects you have developed and why you believe you know best what steps need to be followed to develop this photo &amp; video editing AI.

A visionary with 2+ years in SEO content creation, poised to challenge the status quo.

Driven by curiosity, your mission is to stay ahead of digital marketing trends, fueling your passion for knowledge and innovation.

Join Us:

Apply Now:

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Less than 30 hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 330px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-126" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">We have a client that has a digital library online through WordPress.

We want to build a separate website/ web application where users can interact with an AI bot (GPT Turbo) that has been trained on all of the books in their digital library.

Users will ask questions to the AI bot regarding what they're researching, and it will help users find books in the library that are contextually related to the request, and be able to pull excerpts from books and provide the URL where the user can go to read the full book. The application should store copies of user conversations for quality assurance, and those should be available for viewing in the admin panel.

We do not want the book pulling in outside knowledge, if there isn't a book in the library that covers that topic, GPT shouldn't make something up using it's own knowledge base, it should simply say "we don't have any published works in our library that covers that topic" or something like that.

The bot will need a scheduled task to scan the contents of the library's folders for new books to train on as they are added over time.

We have a proof of concept working that you can view, another developer almost finished this project and then ghosted us and didn't give us the code.

Before beginning - I'd like to know an average estimate of what we're looking at in terms of budget to build this. Happy to sit down and discuss this project with the right candidate.

In your response, please tell me what sites or apps you've built that integrate with GPT as well as your general comfort level with the site I'm describing above.

We are looking for an experienced AI Developer to create a custom AI chatbot app that integrates seamlessly with WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram DMs, and Emails. This app will serve as an internal tool for our clients to easily build and deploy AI chatbots across major messaging platforms and will need to integrate effectively into our CRM. We've tried different solutions on the market but are looking to build our own. Your expertise will help us offer a versatile tool that makes digital communication more intuitive and effective for our diverse clientele.

ABOUT US:
At themediafriends.com/en, we are at the forefront of digital marketing and AI innovation, helping our clients navigate the ever-evolving digital landscape. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that enhance user engagement and streamline communication processes. Join us to be a part of a team that values creativity, innovation, and impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Design and develop a multi-platform AI chatbot that integrates with WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram DMs, and Email.
- Implement AI and machine learning models to enable natural language processing and personalized interactions.
- Create a fully functioning web-app that our clients can use for chatbot configuration and management.
- Integrate the Bots with our CRM
- Ensure the security and privacy of user data in compliance with global standards.
- Collaborate with the product team to define feature specifications and deliver high-quality software.
- Optimize chatbot responses and functionalities based on user feedback.
- Provide technical documentation and support for the chatbot platform.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Proven experience in AI development and machine learning, particularly in NLP.
- Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, or other relevant languages.

Department: Data Science and Analytics

Worldwide
Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Flexible/Remote
Department: Data Science and Analytics
Reporting to: Lead Data Engineer


Key Responsibilities:
Conduct comprehensive data analysis to support the mapping of data from 2 old platforms to the new Snowflake-based common data model for North America.
Work closely with the Data Architect to define and validate data mapping rules, ensuring seamless integration of diverse data sets.
Develop and execute SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, ensuring data integrity and alignment with project objectives.
Utilize Python for data preprocessing, cleansing, and automation tasks to enhance data quality and efficiency.
Participate in the testing and validation of data pipelines, employing rigorous analytical methods to identify discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.


Collaborate with the US-based data engineering team to understand the existing data bricks platform and contribute to the migration strategy to Snowflake.
Support the continuous improvement of data models and ETL processes, incorporating feedback from stakeholders to meet evolving business needs
Analyses ticketing data, investigation of complex and or convoluted data issues.

Documentation of business rules and data logic.
Presentation and playback of data and issues to data team.
Prepare and present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Own the data testing and reconciliation efforts.
Conduct data quality assessments, identify gaps, and implement strategies to enhance data integrity.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to understand data trends, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies.
Collaborate with product teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Monitoring and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and integrity.

Essential Skills and Qualifications:
Experience with SQL and familiarity with data warehousing solutions like Snowflake.
Proficient in Python, with a strong preference for candidates with experience in both Python and R.
Solid understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and data modeling.
Experience with data quality assurance and validation techniques.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive insights from complex datasets and translate these into actionable business strategies.
Creative problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing challenges.
Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating complex concepts to diverse audiences, including revenue managers and senior stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, as well as independently with minimal supervision.
Desirable Skills:
Experience with data bricks or similar platforms.
Familiarity with AWS services and DBT.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate insights.
Understanding of the entertainment or ticketing industry is a plus

We are a fast-growing, fully remote content agency specializing in data science and technology. Currently, we're enhancing our content marketing efforts to produce a variety of content, including newsletters, ads, and promotional materials, alongside our regular blogs and videos. We're building a team adept in data science communication to support our clients' SEO and marketing strategies.

The Role:
As a Copywriter/Copy Editor at our agency, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the voice of data science in marketing materials. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented professional who can produce and refine content that is not only engaging but also rooted in data science and technology. Your focus will be on creating content for newsletters, advertising campaigns, and promotional activities that align with the intricacies of data science and growth.

Key Responsibilities:

-Develop and edit content for newsletters, advertising, and promotional campaigns, ensuring relevance to data science and technology.
-Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure content aligns with data science concepts and marketing objectives.
-Apply SEO best practices to create impactful and search-friendly copy
-Translate complex data science concepts into accessible and compelling copy.

Preferred Qualifications:

-Expertise in copywriting and copy-editing, particularly in a data science or technology-focused environment.
-Demonstrated experience or a strong interest in SEO, particularly for marketing content.
-Ability to interpret and communicate complex data science topics in an engaging manner.
-Eagerness to engage with the latest trends in data science, technology, and digital marketing.
-Independence and motivation to thrive in a remote, startup-like environment.

To apply, include the word 'IQ' in your proposal as a confirmation that you have fully read and understood the job description and our company's focus.

- Previous work in a startup environment and the ability to handle rapid development cycles.
- Advanced degree in Computer Science, AI, or related field.

**Compensation and Benefits:**
- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
- Flexible working hours and remote work options.
- Professional development opportunities and access to advanced tools and technologies.

**How to Apply:**

Location: Flexible/Remote
Department: Data Science and Analytics
Reporting to: Lead Data Engineer
Working time: 9:00am – 6pm EET

Key Responsibilities:
Conduct comprehensive data analysis to support the mapping of data from 2 old platforms to the new Snowflake-based common data model for North America.
Work closely with the Data Architect to define and validate data mapping rules, ensuring seamless integration of diverse data sets.
Develop and execute SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, ensuring data integrity and alignment with project objectives.
Utilize Python for data preprocessing, cleansing, and automation tasks to enhance data quality and efficiency.
Participate in the testing and validation of data pipelines, employing rigorous analytical methods to identify discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.


Collaborate with the US-based data engineering team to understand the existing data bricks platform and contribute to the migration strategy to Snowflake.
Support the continuous improvement of data models and ETL processes, incorporating feedback from stakeholders to meet evolving business needs
Analyses ticketing data, investigation of complex and or convoluted data issues.

Documentation of business rules and data logic.
Presentation and playback of data and issues to data team.
Prepare and present findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.&nbsp;
Own the data testing and reconciliation efforts.
Conduct data quality assessments, identify gaps, and implement strategies to enhance data integrity.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to understand data trends, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies.
Collaborate with product teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Monitoring and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and integrity.

Essential Skills and Qualifications:
Experience with SQL and familiarity with data warehousing solutions like Snowflake.
Proficient in Python, with a strong preference for candidates with experience in both Python and R.
Solid understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and data modeling.
Experience with data quality assurance and validation techniques.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive insights from complex datasets and translate these into actionable business strategies.
Creative problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing challenges.
Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating complex concepts to diverse audiences, including revenue managers and senior stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, as well as independently with minimal supervision.
Desirable Skills:
Experience with data bricks or similar platforms.
Familiarity with AWS services and DBT.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate insights.
Understanding of the entertainment or ticketing industry is a plus

We are on a mission to revolutionize e-commerce for Amazon vendors by developing an advanced virtual GPT-based team. Inspired by ChatDev and CrewAI, this project is not just about creating another complex QA engine; it's about simulating the dynamic, interconnected workings of an Amazon sales agency with AI agents that proactively solve problems, identify trends, and make strategic decisions. We are seeking an AI/ML expert with a deep understanding of creating such intelligent systems, someone who can think beyond the traditional Q&amp;A functionalities to build AI agents that act as real team members within a digital ecosystem.

Your Role:

Design and develop AI agents for roles such as Inventory Manager, Sales Analyst, Account Manager, etc., tailored for the e-commerce sector, especially focused on Amazon.
Implement AI systems that not only respond to queries but also proactively analyze data, identify trends, communicate with each other, and suggest actionable insights.
Incorporate feedback loops where AI agents learn and adapt strategies based on the dynamic e-commerce landscape and inter-agent communications.
Build a system where AI agents collaborate to offer consolidated insights and actionable recommendations, simulating the real-world interactions of an Amazon sales agency.

We Need You To Have:

Intimate knowledge of both ChatDev’s and CrewAI’s codebase.
Strong expertise in AI, ML, and GPT-based systems, with a focus on creating proactive and interactive AI agents.
Experience in developing applications for e-commerce, particularly Amazon, with an understanding of the platform's unique challenges and opportunities.
A visionary approach to AI development, moving beyond information retrieval to simulate complex decision-making and problem-solving dynamics.
A creative mindset to explore new use cases, constantly pushing the boundaries of what AI can achieve in the e-commerce domain.

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Hours to be determined</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 330px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-175" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">I lead a Private Equity fund and am looking to build a simple LLM system for copywriting custom outreach fields in bulk.

The requirements are:
Inputs: Spreadsheet with company name, website, industry... and possibly a company owner LinkedIn URL.  The app should be able to output the copywriting fields with as many or as little inputs as are present.
Output: Short copywriting excerpts (e.g., industry description, unique offerings, and a personal connection to the owner) - see example file attached
Volume: a few hundred entries at a time / per week, with capability for bulk processing.

ML component: I would like to be able to provide examples to have the model train on (ie build a custom agent on). I also want to be able to provide feedback to the model, so that it learns to write in my "voice" over time and incorporates any changes I make to the copy. I would also like to be able to tweak the prompt for copywriting best practices, eg "go for more simplicity" or "make the wording more casual" or "follow the copywriting best practices in this article"

This is meant to be scrappy. The most important thing is for this to be simple, both in terms of build and UI. It can be a simple web app, or it can also live in something like Airtable. It is not crucial for the model to be highly performant or specialized through training, just that my feedback gets incorporated into the custom agent.

Project Overview:
Seeking a Machine Learning developer to build a simple swipe automation tool for personal use on MacOS. The tool will learn from a limited dataset of user swipes and perform actions on dating apps.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop a basic ML model to predict swipe preferences.
- Script interactions with dating app interfaces.
- Create a straightforward interface for user control.
- Perform initial adjustments and basic testing.

Skills Required:
- Python and basic ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn).
- Experience with Selenium or similar for web interaction.

1. Preference Learning
Task 1.1: Research and select appropriate machine learning algorithms suitable for preference prediction.
Task 1.2: Design the data model to capture user swipe data and preferences.
Task 1.3: Implement data collection mechanisms to gather swipe data from user interactions.
Task 1.4: Develop the initial machine learning model using the collected data.
Task 1.5: Test the model with initial data sets to assess prediction accuracy.

2. App Interaction Automation
Task 2.1: Analyze and document the APIs of target dating apps, if available, or plan for UI automation where APIs are not accessible.
Task 2.2: Develop scripts to automate swipe actions based on model predictions.
Task 2.3: Integrate the automation scripts with the machine learning model to act on predicted preferences.
Task 2.4: Test the integration to ensure accurate execution of swipe actions.

3. Basic Testing
Task 3.1: Develop test cases covering both the machine learning model predictions and the interaction automation.
Task 3.2: Implement logging and monitoring to track the behavior of automated interactions and model performance.

Deliverables:
- A desktop or extension tool that automates swipe actions across the different dating apps.
- User interface for operation management.
- Usage and modification documentation.

Budget: fixed.

Application:
Include:
- A concise proposal of your approach.
- Examples of relevant past projects.
- Contact for one reference.

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Less than 30 hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 220px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-205" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Looking for someone to write code/models to tag the skills found in resumes and job descriptions.

We have a reference database of skills to find in each document. We also have a database of thousands of documents with skills already tagged.  Looking to go beyond basic keyword matching and tag skills that have the same meaning (synonyms, acronyms, different spellings, etc.)

e.g. "Gen AI"  and "Generative Artificial Intelligence" should be a hit for reference skill "Generative AI" without humans building a strict taxonomy containing all matching keywords.

Metrics for success:
- % of skills in resume correctly tagged (recall)
- % of tagged skills found in resume (precision)
- throughput of process, documents per second

The solution needs to scale to thousands of skills and tens of thousands of resumes with minimal human intervention. An additional constraint is that we should not have to retrain a model every time a new skill is added to the database.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-205" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Skill extraction from resumes"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Our current designs are created in Canva using illustrations and elements designed by a designer. Some of our illustrations include caricatures of employees, while others do not.

We would like to feed our existing illustration outputs (with text) into AI and have AI generate a large number of illustration options (without text) that we can choose from. Once we select the outputs we like, we will apply text in Canva and use them in social media and blog posts.

Every six months, we would like to provide AI with all the illustrations we have used up to that point, including those generated by AI in the previous six months. This will allow AI to generate more illustrations and designs that align with our branding. It is important that AI does not generate text, as we need to be able to add our own text in the future.

To achieve this, we need to be able to use the AI system ourselves. We would like your assistance in selecting the system, providing inputs, obtaining outputs, and teaching the system what we like and dislike about the initial outputs so that they can be improved. Our goal is to end up with 30-40 graphics that we can use and to have the knowledge to repeat the process in the future.

Our overall goal is to use a system that only charges us for the outputs. We would prefer the outputs to be in a format that we can edit in Canva, but if that is not possible, we can import high-quality "flat" AI-generated files into Canva and add text.

Introduction:
At UPA, we are dedicated to harnessing the power of artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems and enhance our digital solutions. We are seeking a skilled Full Stack AI Developer to join our dynamic team. This role involves integrating AI capabilities into our existing infrastructure and developing both backend and, optionally, frontend components of our applications.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop robust backend services with a focus on integrating AI functionalities.
- Enhance and maintain our current software infrastructure with innovative AI solutions.

- If capable, assist with frontend development to ensure seamless integration with backend services.

- Lead and contribute to projects from conception to final product, requiring good organizational skills and attention to detail.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field; Master’s degree is a plus.

- Knowledge of modern backend frameworks (e.g., Node.js, Django, Flask).
- Understanding of databases (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB), web servers (e.g., Apache) and UI/UX design is beneficial.
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
- Knowledge of frontend technologies (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Angular) is a plus but not required.

What We Offer:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for professional development and growth.
- Collaborative and innovative work environment.
- Access to the latest tools and technology.
- Flexible working hours and remote work options.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit a resume and a cover letter explaining why they are a perfect fit for the position. Please include a portfolio of past projects that showcase your abilities relevant to this role.

The goal of this project is to automate the generation of high-quality product evaluation content. Objective: Develop an API integration between OpenAI/Gemini and WordPress to automate the generation of high-quality product evaluation content. The content will be generated using OpenAI's GPT/Gemini models. Additional content will be provided for detailed models training in a database. The generated content must be structured to include all necessary fields for direct publishing on WordPress, such as title, body, categories, and tags.

Key Features: Customizable Prompt Templates: Develop a set of customizable prompt templates for content generation. These templates will have placeholders for keywords and product-specific data to guide the AI in generating relevant and informative content.

AI Integration: Integrate with the AI API to send customized prompts filled with product data and keywords. Handle the API responses and format the generated content according to WordPress's requirements.

WordPress Integration: Automate the process of publishing the generated content on a WordPress site. This includes creating new posts with the generated content, categorizing them appropriately, and tagging them with relevant keywords.

User Interface: Create a user interface for managing prompt templates, initiating content generation requests, reviewing and editing generated content before publication.
Database Integration: Implement functionality to train the models with specific content

Scalability: The system should be designed to handle a growing amount of product data and an increasing frequency of content generation requests.

      <span><span>Est. Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Less than 30 hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 814px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-227" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">I need support improving the code for an algorithm we have already developed (in Google Earth Engine using JavaScript)

The code takes a polygon anywhere in the U.S. and calculates the above ground biomass using random forest training on a host of variables. The data inputs include around 12 indices and the GEDI dataset and use these indices to improve the predictability of areas where GEDI is not covered.

I need the following completed by the end of the week, delivered as a JavaScript code that I can than run in Google Earth Engine. The Code will be shared with you upon initiation of the contract. If the deliverable is satisfactory, would love to continue working together!

The items I need support with are:
1. Executing a logistic regression between the training and sample points (the code is close, but getting errors in that step). I need to assess the R2, RMSE, and overall accuracy of the model.
2. Enable the trained model to then take new data from different years of sentinnel-derived indices to create new estimates of above ground biomass
3. Improve the output resolution to 10 m (the resolution of sentinnel imagery)


The overview of the code is as follows:

EXISTING CODE (description, full code will be shared with you):

Define Study Area:

A FeatureCollection of U.S. counties is loaded using the TIGER dataset for the year 2018.
It filters this collection to include only counties in New York State (STATEFP = '36'). Specifically, it further narrows down to the county named 'Columbia'.
The geometry() method is then used to extract the combined geometries of these counties, referred to as the studyArea.

Load and Display Additional Features:

Loads a custom FeatureCollection named 'GreatWonder' from a specified asset.
Displays this feature and its minimum bounding rectangle on the map, with the rectangle styled in red.

Remote Sensing Data Operations:

Imports a collection of Landsat 8 images for the year 2020.
Filters these images to those that overlap with the studyArea and applies a cloud and shadow mask.
Mosaics the filtered images into a single composite and clips it to the studyArea.
Selects certain spectral bands and calculates various vegetation indices (e.g., NDVI, EVI, SAVI) and other indices related to water content and vegetation health.
Terrain Analysis:

Retrieves elevation data from the SRTM dataset and calculates slope and aspect.
Clips these terrain layers to the studyArea and adds them to the map with specific color schemes for visualization.
Biomass Estimation Using LIDAR Data:

Loads GEDI LIDAR data and clips it to the studyArea.
Selects specific layers related to biomass and displays them.
Feature Engineering for Machine Learning:

Combines the various indices, slope, aspect, elevation, and biomass data into a single dataset.
Samples this dataset within the studyArea to generate a training dataset for a Random Forest regression model.

Model Training and Biomass Prediction:

Trains a Random Forest model using the prepared features and predicts above-ground biomass.
Displays predicted biomass with visualization parameters, and assesses prediction accuracy through sampling and comparison with observed data. (ERROR AT THIS STAGE)

Statistical Analysis and Visualization: (ERROR AT THIS STAGE)

Calculates basic statistics (min, max, mean) and quartiles for the predicted biomass.
Prepares a scatter plot to compare observed and predicted biomass values.

Specific Use Case - Farm Carbon Estimation:

Calculates the total and average predicted biomass within the bounds of the 'GreatWonder' feature, providing insights into the biomass content of the farm area.

(THEN - NEW ASSESSMENT BASED ON NEW DATE INPUT. FOR EXAMPLE - INPUTTING 2017 AND THE ALGORITHM ASSESSES THE AGB FOR THAT DATE.)</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-227" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Google Earth Engine Machine Learning"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="">

      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 792px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-235" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Experienced NLP Python developer for developing a Proof of Concept for Automatic Speech Recognition for an under-resourced language.

Looking for a NLP developer to build a Proof of Concept (POC) for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) in a roman under-resourced language (Corsican) for 1 to 2 weeks project.
Must be self-starter, ability to work independently, proficient in TensorFlow, Python, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred), familiar with model training, evaluation, and deployment processes, able to articulate clear requirements for the training data, and advise on GPU estimates. Able to clearly articulate and document what is being done for handover.
The work consists of setting-up a minimal first POC for an ASR in Corsican that is easily maintainable and can be improved over time by re-training the model as we collect additional training data.
The chosen ASR model to be trained in Corsican is the open source Whisper multilanguage model. The whisper model has not been pre-trained on Corsican language so for efficiency and to keep to a low cost POC, the first  baseline version for the POC will leverage the Whisper tokenisation toolset using the Italian language.  Italian is chosen as it is a language phonologically similar to Corsican.

Work description:
1.	Create ASR model notebook using the open-source Whisper model. (Steps and notebook should re-use as much as possible the following tooling described https://huggingface.co/learn/audio-course/chapter5/fine-tuning  )
2.	Pre-process the data using Whisper feature extractor, Tokenizer (in Italian) and Processor.
3.	Establish Word Error Rate (WER) as the measure for model performance and create a sample visual dashboard.
4.	Train the model, fine-tune, and evaluate performance.
5.	Host POC model on cloud platform (preference is AWS SageMaker)
6.	This POC scope includes defining how the training data should be stored (where, what labels, what format), and advise on training data volume, so it can then be scaled up with help from Linguists.
7.	Upload training data to Cloud platform (preferred AWS S3). There is minimal volume of training data at this stage.
8.	Establish a reusable process for re-training and re-deployment of the model and dataset versioning
9.	Follow best practices to minimize hosting costs.
10.	Develop a simple use case to demonstrate the model,
11.	Identify data requirements for extending Whisper tokenisation to Corsican language (ex: phoneme dictionary, pronunciation model, token exclusions ?)
12.	Provide a development estimate for developing Corsican tokenization tooling.
13.	Document all steps, code and conduct step by step handover.

Key Deliverables:
1.	Model notebook
2.	Model performance measurement page (very simple dashboard with results)
3.	Trained model hosted on Cloud
4.	Training data hosted on cloud
5.	Simple use case to demonstrate ASR
6.	Data requirements for extending tokenisation feature to Corsican Language
7.	Development estimate for extending tokenisation feature to Corsican Language

Potential for more work:
•	Develop the tokenisation module in Corsican language
•	Development of a simple web app for easily collecting crowd-funded training data.
•	Scaling of the ASR project
•	Future NLP development for Corsican language

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to empower linguistic diversity , have expertise in developing NLP, are a self-starter , comfortable to work with ambiguity at the start of an exciting project, ability to go for the essential and minimise risks and costs, I would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of our mission to develop ASR for the Corsican language.

Look no further! We present a lucrative partnership opportunity with profit sharing for individuals or agencies keen on selling subscriptions to our groundbreaking Telegram bot.

Our Bot:

Our Telegram bot is an advanced tool synchronized with GPT chat, currently in development Midjourney, with additional features on the horizon. Users can acquire subscriptions or token packages to access the bot's services. Subscriptions include a daily allotment of tokens for engaging with the GPT chat, with choices for X2, X3, or X5 token multipliers. The bot supports 14 of the most widely spoken languages globally and offers various modes, such as psychologist, code consultant, and more.

Subscription Pricing:

Weekly: $1.99 (110,000 tokens daily)
Monthly: $5.99 (110,000 tokens daily)
Annual: $59.99 (110,000 tokens daily)
For instance, the X3 multiplier subscription entails:

Weekly: $5.97 (330,000 tokens daily)
Monthly: $17.97 (330,000 tokens daily)
Annual: $179.97 (330,000 tokens daily)
Token Package Pricing:

500K tokens: $5.99
1M tokens: $8.99
3M tokens: $19.99
10M tokens: $59.99
50M tokens: $249.99
Profit Sharing Proposal:

We extend a generous profit sharing proposition to our partners. As a partner, you'll earn a percentage of the profits generated from subscription sales based on your contribution. We believe in fairly rewarding our partners for their hard work and commitment.

Your Expectations:

We encourage you to share your expectations regarding profit sharing. Kindly specify the percentage of profits you deem fair and in line with your sales objectives and efforts. We're open to negotiating terms that are mutually beneficial and rewarding for both parties.

Benefits of Partnership:

Opportunity to earn significant profits through commission-based sales of subscription plans and token packages.
Flexible work arrangement with remote opportunities, enabling you to work at your own pace and convenience.
Access to marketing materials, training, and support to aid you in successfully selling subscriptions to our Telegram bot.
Collaboration with a dynamic and innovative team committed to revolutionizing the digital assistant industry.
Interested?

If you're intrigued by the idea of joining our partnership program and contributing to the success of our Telegram bot, kindly submit your proposal outlining your sales experience, profit-sharing expectations, and why you'd be an ideal partner for this opportunity.

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">not_sure</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 506px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-254" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">We are seeking a qualified AI consultant to assist with a project involving the comparison of two sets of architectural plans for a six-story apartment hotel. The goal is to identify similarities and differences between the plans, focusing on elements that may be protected under copyright law, such as the overall design and layout, unique design elements, artistic embellishments, spatial relationships, materials and finishes, and architectural details.

Scope of Work:
Image Preprocessing:
Convert the architectural plans provided to a suitable format for analysis. This may include resizing to a consistent resolution and removing noise or artifacts to ensure accurate comparisons.

Feature Extraction:
Utilize advanced computer vision techniques, including edge detection, line detection, shape analysis, and text recognition, to extract key features from the architectural plans. Identify elements such as walls, doors, windows, decorative motifs, and architectural details.

Comparison Metrics:
Determine appropriate metrics for comparing the architectural plans, focusing on text, layout, dimensions, spatial arrangements, geometric shapes, proportions, scale, balance, and rhythm.

Similarity Analysis:
Calculate similarity scores between the extracted features of each of the six floors in the two sets of plans and of the overall plans, considering the frequency and distribution of architectural elements, spatial relationships between components, and overall design characteristics.

Visualization :
Present the results in side-by-side visualizations with highlighted similarities and differences, heatmaps indicating areas of similarity or divergence, and textual summaries describing the findings.

Qualifications:

Demonstrated expertise in computer vision, image analysis, and AI.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, along with familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks such as ImageNet, COCO (Common Objects in Context), ADE20K, NYU Depth V2,  and Image Comparison Libraries such as OpenCV, and Frameworks such as scikit-image, and TensorFlow,

If you have the necessary skills and experience to undertake this project, please submit your proposal outlining your qualifications, past experience, and approach to addressing the project requirements. Or just ask clarifying questions.   Thanks!

1.. Project Overview:
Griffin Digital seeks to develop an AI-powered CRM enhancement tailored for the insurance brokerage industry.
The MVP will focus on essential functionalities to streamline document processing and provide initial financial insights.

2. Key Features of the MVP:

Speech-Enabled Interface: Basic command set for navigating the system and inputting data, allowing hands-free operation.

Document Processing and Scoring: AI-driven system to scan, categorize, and initially score documents based on predefined criteria.

Basic Financial Dashboard: Display key financial metrics derived from processed documents, providing brokers with rudimentary insights.

User Authentication and Basic Client Management:

Secure login and minimal profile management functionalities for brokers.

3. Non-Functional Requirements:

Security: Basic security measures including secure login and data encryption.Scalability: System architecture should support future expansion.

Usability: Intuitive user interface suitable for non-technical users.

4. Technology Stack:

EXAMPLE:
(Keep in mind this is a GoHighLevel App!)

Front-End: React.js for a responsive web application.

Back-End: Node.js with Express for server-side logic.

Database: MongoDB for storing user and document data.AI/ML

Processing: Python-based machine learning models for document scoring.

Hosting: AWS or similar for application hosting and management.

5. Project Deliverables:
A functioning web application meeting the MVP feature set.
Basic documentation for system operation and troubleshooting.
Source code and necessary deployment files.

6. Timeline

The ideal candidate for this project should demonstrate:
- Expertise in process design and automation.
- Mastery in Python programming and Local LLM.
- Familiarity with MS Teams as a communication platform for ticket number distribution.
- A deep understanding of ticketing systems and allocation strategies - ServiceNow

effective prompts. These prompts will guide Gemini towards generating precise
task trees, outlining the steps needed to cook specific dishes.
Here is the starter code :
https://github.com/sadman3/project3-starter-code.git
Input:
● Dish name and preferred ingredients
● Available ingredients and utensils in the kitchen (including their states - e.g.,
chopped onions, clean pot)
The cafeteria menu assigned to you will be found here:
https://usf.campusdish.com/en/locationsandmenus/tampa/thehub/

23rdLunch from the above link to create input data(attached already)


Task:
Your challenge is to design at least three different prompting approaches that
incorporate several examples of task tree generation for cooking meals. This will
equip Gemini with the necessary knowledge to create accurate task trees for any
given dish. You should compare those approaches, figure out their pros and cons,
and report their performances.
Output:
Task trees for each dish in the cafeteria menu

      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 418px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-299" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced data scientist to join our team and help analyze data on the types of cyber attacks targeting IoT devices in our factory. The ideal candidate will be able to clean the data, visualize it effectively, and build multiple multiclass classification models to predict different forms of attacks.

Responsibilities:

Clean and preprocess data on IoT attacks to ensure its quality and consistency.
Perform exploratory data analysis to identify meaningful trends and correlations.
Design and develop interactive visualizations to present results clearly and comprehensibly.
Build multiclass classification models, including XGBoost, decision trees, LSTM, and Random Forest, to predict attack types.
Optimize model hyperparameters to maximize accuracy and performance.
Collaborate with the team to interpret model results and recommend actions based on insights gained.

Required Skills:

Strong experience in data cleaning and preprocessing.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques and tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly.
Expertise in building and evaluating classification models using libraries like Scikit-learn and TensorFlow.
Deep understanding of hyperparameter optimization methods.
Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and IoT attacks.
Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with the team.

Additional Requirements:

The ideal candidate will have prior experience in the field of cybersecurity or embedded systems.
We are looking for someone who can work flexibly and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in multiple programming languages, such as Python and R, is an advantage.
If you are passionate about data analysis and have the necessary experience to take on this challenge, we would love to discuss this exciting opportunity with you. Please include examples of relevant past projects in your application.
