      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 660px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-303" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">We are looking for meditation / visualization app testers.

What we’re doing:

We’re testing out an app that we’ve developed called Time-Machine. Our goal is to see whether humans have the ability to visualize a future outcome while in a mildly meditative state. I know… it sounds a little crazy, but this does work, and the science behind it is really very deep. To date, we have collectively completed 3978 trials which have been 52% correct in predicting their respective future outcomes resulting in over 2.7 standard deviations from chance expectation. This translates to odds against chance of approximately 1 in 315.6. This means that such an outcome is highly unlikely to occur by random chance, indicating that the guesses (predictions) are not simply random.

Here is what the job entails:

At some point, once per day whenever you choose, you must spend at least 30 minutes in a mildly meditative state working your way through 10 trials performing some visualization tasks using the Time-Machine web app. We use an A.I. model to analyze your 10 trials to make 1 prediction. Therefore, 10 trials = 1 prediction.

You must use a desktop, laptop, or tablet computer. Due to the small screen, a smart phone is not acceptable.

Complete 1 prediction (10 trials) each day for 5 consecutive days, for a total of up to 5 predictions for the week.

This is what we will pay you based on your prediction success:

1 correct prediction out of 5 predictions = $5
2 correct predictions out of 5 predictions  = $5
3 correct predictions out of 5 predictions = $10
4 correct predictions out of 5 predictions = $25
5 correct predictions out of 5 predictions = $50

5 consecutive predictions completes the payment cycle. For example:
For Week 1, you complete a prediction on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
For Week 2, you complete a prediction on Monday.
This completes your set of 5 predictions and you will be paid based on the above incentive schedule.

Since the predictions are a binary choice, 50% correct is the mean. So, you should average at least 2.5 correct days each week if you are performing at average random chance. But I know that you will do better than that

For your 5 predictions, a milestone will be added in Upwork and funded with $5. Based on your prediction success for the 5 predictions, the milestone dollar amount will be adjusted and paid based on the above incentive schedule.

This job post is for 5 paid predictions. If you have a good handle on the process and are a high performer, a new milestone will be set up with 5 more paid predictions. If you complete 10 predictions and continue to be a high performer, there is an opportunity for a permanent position on our team (contingent on performance). That's right, you can be a professional time traveler! ;-)

Training:

If you accept, then I’ll hire you on Upwork.

From there, please provide me with your email and I'll send you a training package which consists of a bit of reading and a very short user guide video.

I look forward to you joining our team of “time travelers”!!

Best regards,
Greg Kolodziejzyk </span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-303" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Exploring Benefits of Meditation Techniques"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">not_sure</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 924px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-305" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">[UPDATE: Thank you for the interest in our project! We have received more than 20 proposals in a single day which is a great sign of the skill and vitality on this platform. We are reviewing applications and will get back to all applicants within a few days. If you believe you are a great fit (and are not too obviously using an LLM to compose an answer) you are still welcome to apply!]

We are developing an usb flash drive linux live system for students and makers:
https://github.com/fsfw-dresden/usb-live-linux/
From practical use during recent years, we have derived two chunks of potential for better usability.

1) We want to implement a portal app that provides several distinct features, such as
- news feed
- buttons to install 3rd party tools (zoom etc)
- support channel (support chat, remote assistance with rustdesk)
- video tutorial catalog and player (borderless, similar to the video pop outs in firefox)

It should be
- responsive &amp; intuitive
- have modes for accessibility vs fancyness
- nice fluid layout
  - PyQt6 ? (non-commercial use)
  - PyFluentWidgets ?
- animated cartoon avatars? (see mockups further below)

2) From experience in our school courses, many times, neither worksheets nor lecture-style instructions help the kids explore and use the software in an effective way. What seems to work best is giving each kid individual guidance. As the number of IT-competent teachers does not scale up well enough, we want to create a free open source universal desktop assistant that
- has a catalogue of known open source programs, can demonstrate how to use them
- can generate walkthrough tutorials
- assist the user in learning to apply the program to his ideas &amp; challenges
- gamification: give the learner challenges, give him feedback and collectibles
- provides or integrates with stick portal app

Ideal Solution
- FLOSS
- runs well on a 10yo laptop
- modular
- usable as library

When we originally planned the project, we wanted to implement it with a more conventional approach:
- segmentation (YOLO, openCV etc.)
  - research example: https://scholar.google.de/scholar?cites=13279157065849904715
- OCR (paddleOCR, tesseract)
  - research example: https://repository.tudelft.nl/islandora/object/uuid:34986f5b-3087-41cd-9068-b05084627030
- We also had two students do extensive mockups of how such a learning assistant could look and feel. You can find the two click-through PDFs attached (If your native tongue is not german, google lens is the easiest solution I guess.. is there a less monstrous option?).

Then, at the turn of 2023/24, GUI agents powered by vision language models enter the stage. "CogAgent" seems to be the first practical general software robot and has already been followed by a handful of other robot agent frameworks or models:
https://scholar.google.de/scholar?cites=11749002511260467707

Current issue:
- Sizes like 30gig (CogAgent model on huggingface): that's a bit much for a pen drive distro
  - possible solution: 1.58 bit model weights (1, 0, -1)
    c.f. https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39535800
- might depend on special hardware or require a lot of memory

Notes:
- training / fine-tuning approach:
  - recursive program interaction exploration +docs +source code (+git history?)
  - single shot learning?
- future readiness: ability to swap the ai model?
- provide user assistance with finding requirements?
- hotloading resources / standby mode to conserve memory

Ideal Candidate:
- has a grasp of the field (AI agents &amp; desktop GUIs) and how it is developing
- has routine in completing projects well
- has a passion for Open Educational Resources and Open Source Software
- facilitates our participation and steering of the project along the way
- able to research relevant current models on huggingface / open source GUI agents f.e. on google scholar
- willing to interact with model authors f.e. on github to collaborate on research

Our offer: 42$/h
We'll be glad to provide clarification via mail or jitsi. We welcome all questions!

Our first questions:
Why are you a good candidate?
Do you feel comfortable doing both parts of the project or would you prefer to tackle one or the other?
How far do you think can you get with 200h?
How would you assess the feasibility of the project? Are you an AI specialist who is itching to sink your teeth into the next creative project?

We run a custom apparel business - screen printing, embroidery, headwear &amp; promo items. We produce bulk apparel for businesses, organizations and events.

We are looking to scale our operations by utilizing AI to take orders from new customers when they are directed to our landing page.  Most of our customers come from email campaigns we send out to potential customers.

We currently have a massive bottleneck when a customer is interested in getting a quote - we must manually discuss their needs and provide pricing once we figure out what they need along with mockups.
A high percentage of customers do not end up placing an order and a large amount of time is wasted.

Imagine if you need 100 tshirts for your next event, but don't know what you want or where to order. You come to our landing page -- how can use AI to make the experience good enough you actually order the items?

We want to create an interactive AI solution that allows customers to work to get what they want, get mockups, get pricing based on their job, and ultimately place the order.

This will be an in-depth project completed in phases. Starting simple and expanding as we go.

Please see the google doc here with our initial thoughts on the phases.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1R0_otpdLzuRqoTPxf9TMFceS-9mpwGw-__dMrJNZ47c/edit

Due to the large amount of applications, we will prioritize candidates who provide some input on their solution when applying. This would include tools to be used, if you have completed anything that is similar, timelines, and why you think you are a good fit for the project.

For example, what tools would you use to create the user experience we need to be successful? How would it be integrated to our site?

We expect to continue to expand this project to cover multiple phases and continuously improve it - so the right fit can expect to stick around for quite some time.

If you are interested in this project, please reach out and explain what your thoughts are and why you would be a good fit.

I'm seeking assistance with organizing a list of 500 UK postcodes based on their geographical locations. My objective is to group these postcodes into 42 clusters, each consisting of approximately 12 postcodes. I already have the dataset; I just need help with the clustering process.

What I Need:

1, Clustering Expertise: I require someone with experience in clustering geographical data to help me group the postcodes effectively.

2, Implementation: Utilize the provided dataset to apply clustering algorithms and group the postcodes by their proximity to one another.

3, Validation: Ensure that the clustering results make sense geographically and meet the desired grouping criteria.
4,Documentation: Provide documentation outlining the methodology used, as well as any insights or observations derived from the clustering process.

Who I'm Looking For:

I'm seeking someone who is proficient in data analysis and clustering techniques, particularly in the context of geographical data. It's essential that the individual can work with existing datasets and implement clustering algorithms effectively.

As an Automation &amp; AI Specialist at Yobi, you'll be part of a team focused on leveraging technology to optimize our processes and drive business growth. We're looking for someone with a passion for problem-solving and a drive to stay at the forefront of automation and AI technologies. This role offers the opportunity to tackle complex challenges and contribute to the long-term success of our organization.

Availability:
Must be available to work during PST business hours as HQ is located in San Jose, California.

Must-Have Qualifications:
1. Minimum of 5 years of experience in automation, process mining, and process optimization.

5. Strong communication and documentation skills.
6. Willingness to embrace non-traditional work hours and adapt to fluctuating schedules as needed. Must be open to occasional long hours and weekend work to meet project deadlines and business demands.
7. A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and a creative approach to problem-solving.

Additional Skills:
1. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
2. Knowledge of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum)
3. Familiarity with the dynamics of startup cultures, including an understanding of the inherent challenges and opportunities.
4. Understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms

Responsibilities:
1. Drive the strategic direction of automation and generative AI initiatives within the organization.
2. Implement and optimize automation technologies to improve efficiency and productivity.
3. Explore innovative applications for generative AI and lay the groundwork for its ethical and effective use.
4. Set measurable goals for automation and AI projects and track their impact on business outcomes.
5. Develop and document best practices and guidelines for the responsible deployment of automation and AI technologies.

A brief summary of the project: A desktop app or browser plug-in for the recruitment industry. The app would float over LinkedIn profiles and, based on keywords that have been entered by the users, can scan the LinkedIn profile that it is seeing and generate a match score. The match score would incorporate criteria set out by the user, such as which keywords are being detected, how often, and in what part of the profile (past job, current job, etc.).

Other variations or iterations of this:
- Similar high-level idea as above, but using ChatGPT to accomplish all of the above. I.E., provide ChatGPT with a resume and ask it if what is displayed on screen is a match.
- Exact same high-level idea as above, but storing all the keywords that are being entered, and information on how profiles identified are being evaluated (i.e. the app displays a profile is a great fit, and I say no, it's not), to create a database that can eventually be used to improve the matching accuracy. (AI?)

I would like to speak with someone who is an expert in software development to help me understand the feasibility of this, what stacks would be used, approximate complexity of this project in terms of estimated hours of work, etc.

This project is intended as 1 to 3 hour consultation (split into multiple sessions), but can develop into the actual project, if you have the right stack to actually work on this from a technical perspective.

Here's a refined description incorporating the details about the previous labs and the existing skeleton code:

Project Overview:
This robotics project is a culmination of concepts learned in previous modules and requires the application of computer vision and autonomous navigation skills. The aim is to develop a program for a Turtlebot that will navigate through a simulated spacecraft environment, with the ultimate goal of aiding a virtual mission control in localizing the spacecraft by acquiring visual information from designated windows showing Earth and the Moon


Objectives:
1. Employ ROS to program a Turtlebot for both simulation and potential real-world application.
2. Implement and refine computer vision algorithms to detect specific targets within the spacecraft.
3. Create a panoramic image by stitching together views from identified windows.
4. Calculate the necessary distances using provided scaling factors and assumptions.
5. Complete the task within a five-minute window to simulate real-world time constraints.

Project Build-up:
The task builds upon prior work from previous labs. You will leverage and expand upon existing code, including a provided skeleton code framework, to jumpstart the development process. Your program should seamlessly integrate with the existing codebase, applying improvements and new features to meet the project objectives.

**Deliverables:**
- Modified and improved code that builds on the existing lab code and skeleton framework.
- Functional image processing to save snapshots of windows as PNG files when the robot identifies them correctly.
- A well-constructed panoramic image file merging the views of Earth and the Moon.
- A text file containing calculated measurements of the distances to the Earth and Moon.
- A detailed report documenting the methodology, execution, and reflection on the project, taking into account the iterative development from previous lab work.

Requirements for the Freelancer:
- Expertise in ROS, computer vision, and autonomous systems.
- Ability to understand and follow complex project specifications and documentation.
- Proficiency in integrating new code with pre-existing codebases.
- Capability to test the solution across different simulated difficulty levels and potentially on a real robot.
- Strong communication skills for collaboration and report writing.

Special Notes:
- The provided skeleton code serves as a starting point; your task will be to enhance its capabilities and ensure it can handle variations in the simulated environment.
- Extra consideration will be given for running experiments on a real Turtlebot, if accessible.
- You will need to validate the robustness of your solution by testing it in varied simulated scenarios.

Time: </span> <span data-test="duration">Less than 30 hrs/week</span></span></span></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 616px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-332" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Analytics Engineer Martech (Freelance)

This role combines technical expertise in data modeling and engineering with a deep understanding of MarTech stacks, ensuring our clients can leverage their data for strategic decision-making.

Adasight helps startups and scale-ups unlock their growth potential with the help of data. As an interdisciplinary team, we bridge growth methodologies with technical expertise and execution.We consist of data-savvy marketers, product analysts, data engineers, and analysts, to tackle what we call Growth Analytics: Combining acquisition-marketing analytics and product analytics.


Overview

The Analytics Engineer will be key in constructing and optimising data infrastructures tailored to our clients' unique needs. This role combines technical expertise in data modeling and engineering with a deep understanding of MarTech stacks, ensuring our clients can leverage their data for strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

- Data Infrastructure Development: Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines, models, and warehouses, supporting marketing and sales initiatives.
- MarTech Integration: Seamlessly integrate MarTech platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Braze  HubSpot, Google Analytics, Segment, Snowflake, Amplitude ensuring efficient data flow and quality.
- Performance Optimization: Enhance data performance and scalability to accommodate large data volumes and support business growth.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, sales, and data science teams to gather and prioritize data requirements, driving key data initiatives.
- Custom Analytics Solutions: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop tailored analytics solutions, meeting unique business demands.
- Industry Leadership: Stay at the forefront of MarTech and data engineering trends, sharing knowledge and insights to foster community growth.
Skills &amp; Qualifications
- Proven Data Engineering Background: Extensive experience in data engineering, with a focus on building and managing client data infrastructure.
- MarTech Stack Expertise: Familiarity with integrating and optimizing MarTech platforms (e.g., Appsflyer, Hubspot, Braze into Amplitude) within client data ecosystems.

Data Scientist Needed for Analysis of IDPro® Skills, Programs &amp; Diversity Survey Results

Job Description:
We are seeking a skilled Data Scientist to conduct a comprehensive analysis of the raw results from the recent IDPro Skills Survey, collected via SurveyMonkey. Our organization is dedicated to advancing the field of identity management, and we've collected a wide range of data points from professionals across the industry. Our annual survey has 19 questions, mostly using structured fields for responses. Your expertise will help us uncover valuable insights, understand industry trends, and analyze demographic influences on survey responses.

Project Objectives:
- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Conduct an exploratory analysis to understand the distributions, relationships, and patterns within the data.
- Trend Identification: Identify key trends within the data, especially those related to the identity management field's current challenges, opportunities, and areas of growth.
- Demographic Analysis: Examine how different demographics (e.g., job roles, experience levels, regions) trend towards specific sets of answers. Highlight any significant correlations or divergences in the responses based on these demographic factors.

Requirements:
- Proven experience in data science and statistical analysis.
- Experience in handling and analyzing survey data, including demographic analysis.
- Ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights.
- Excellent written communication skills for preparing insightful and accessible reports.
- A portfolio or examples of previous data analysis projects.

Budget:
USD $750

Timeline:
The project is expected to be completed within 2 weeks from the start date.

Application Requirements:
Please submit a brief proposal outlining your approach to the project, including any preliminary thoughts on how you would conduct the analysis.

Include examples of similar projects you've worked on, especially those involving survey data and demographic analysis.

Provide an estimated timeline for the project milestones.

Selection Criteria:
Proposals will be evaluated based on the applicant's experience, proposed approach to the project, and ability to meet the project's objectives within the given timeline and budget.

Real-time Odds Scraping: The platform should continuously scrape data from leading Danish bookmakers to ensure that users have access to the latest odds across different sports.

2. Surebet Detection: In addition to displaying odds, the platform should include a surebet detector. Surebets occur when different bookmakers offer conflicting odds on the same event, creating an opportunity for guaranteed profit regardless of the outcome. The surebet detector should scan the odds in real-time and promptly identify surebet opportunities for users to capitalize on.

3. User-Friendly Interface: The website should have a user-friendly interface that allows users to easily navigate between different sports events, view odds from multiple bookmakers, and identify surebets at a glance.

4. Mobile Compatibility: Ensure that the website is mobile-responsive, allowing users to access odds and surebet information seamlessly across various devices, including smartphones and tablets.

Overall, the goal of the project is to create a comprehensive odds comparison platform that provides users with the most accurate and up-to-date information on betting odds while also offering valuable insights into surebet opportunities. Project Objectives:

Avatars that run on UE 5+, streamed on a web browser to simulate human interaction. Full cycle is provided in almost real-time (sub 3sc).

We have big ambitions and need someone who will be with us long-term.

You are our candidate if you have:
* Experience contributing to open source Python repos
* Experience working on production-grade LLM projects
* Experience with Fast API

Experience with UE and blueprints is a plus 👌

When applying, please:

Are you interested, in setting up an AI data storage system without relying on support from Microsoft or AWS? T1 data storage presents an option. It necessitates thorough planning and consideration of crucial details. Here are the key aspects to take into account;

1. **Hardware Needs**; Identify the hardware components, such as servers, storage devices and networking gear required to support your AI data storage requirements.

2. **Software Setup**; Select the software configuration for managing and accessing your data encompassing database management systems, file systems and AI frameworks that align with T1 data storage compatibility.

3. **Data Protection**; Deploy security measures like encryption, access control mechanisms and monitoring systems to protect your data from access and cyber threats.

4. **Expandability**; Construct your system with scalability in mind to allow for expansion of storage capacity and processing capabilities as your AI data needs evolve over time.

5. **Data Backup and Restoration**; Establish procedures, for backing up and recovering data to ensure its integrity and availability in case of hardware failures or other critical situations.
6. **Data Management and Compliance**; Make sure to follow the rules and standards related to data privacy and security taking into account any obligations that apply to your organization or industry.

7. **Financial Oversight**; Keep an eye, on the costs linked to your data storage setup making sure resources are used efficiently and expenses are minimized to ensure cost efficiency.

8. **Performance Monitoring and Improvement**; Use monitoring tools to keep track of system performance and find ways to optimize operations for efficiency ensuring a smooth workflow and optimal resource utilization.

9. **Incorporating AI Systems**; Ensure a connection with your AI systems and workflows for data handling that supports your organizations AI projects effectively.

10. **Record Keeping and Upkeep**; Document your infrastructure design thoroughly establish maintenance routines to keep the system running smoothly over time.

By covering these aspects you can establish a strong foundation for an AI data storage system using T1 technology without relying on support, from Microsoft or AWS. Through planning and implementation you can develop a secure and budget friendly solution tailored specifically to meet your organizations unique needs.

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative AI Developer to join our Travel Planner Project team. The previous iteration of our travel planner did not fully meet our ambitious goals. We are dedicated to refining and perfecting our platform, making it the ultimate tool for creating custom travel itineraries, including flights, hotels, and destinations. Our aim is to develop an AI-driven system that not only meets but exceeds user expectations in planning their travels with ease, accuracy, and personalization.

Responsibilities

- Develop and implement an advanced AI model capable of generating custom travel plans that adapt to a wide range of user inputs and preferences.
- Ensure the AI system is robust enough to handle and intelligently respond to edge cases and unusual user responses without confusion.
- Develop a dynamic conversation flow that allows for flexible user interaction, enabling the AI to understand and adapt to various user behaviors and scenarios.
- Integrate real-time data and scenarios into the AI's recommendations, ensuring users are advised of current events that may impact their travel plans, such as advisories or calamities, and suggest alternatives accordingly.
- Collaborate with developers to ensure a seamless, user-friendly interface that enhances user experience.
- Implement features that upsell products intelligently, based on the user's input and preferences, to maximize revenue without compromising user experience.
- Continuously test, refine, and enhance the AI's capabilities to ensure accuracy, reliability, and relevance of the provided travel plans and recommendations.
- Stay updated with the latest developments in AI, machine learning technologies, and travel industry trends to incorporate into the platform for continual improvement.

Requirements


- Proven experience in AI development, with a strong portfolio showcasing successful AI projects, preferably in the travel or related industries.
- Expertise in natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and AI conversation flow management.
- Strong coding skills in Python used in AI/ML development.
- Experience with real-time data integration and processing.
- Ability to interpret complex user inputs and behaviors, and translate them into effective AI responses and actions.
- Creative problem-solving skills and ability to work in a dynamic, evolving project environment.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-352" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "AI Developer - Travel Planner Enhancement Project"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="">

Project Description:

I need a freelancer to create a program that can visualize data from a CSV file uploaded through a web browser window.

Task Details:

The freelancer will develop a Python script that can read data from a CSV file uploaded by a user.
The script should be able to handle CSV files with various data formats (e.g., numerical, categorical).
The user interface will be a simple web page where users can upload their CSV file.
The script will process the uploaded file and generate a data visualization (e.g., line chart, scatter plot) based on the data. The visualization should be displayed on the same web page.
Example CSV files will be provided to the freelancer for testing purposes.

Deliverables:

Python script for data processing and visualization.
A basic HTML file for the web page user interface (including file upload functionality).
Instructions on how to run the script (including any library dependencies).
Project Requirements:

Experience with Python programming, including data manipulation libraries (e.g., pandas).
Familiarity with basic web development concepts (HTML).
Ability to create clear and concise visualizations.
Additional Information:

The preferred visualization library for this project is Matplotlib (https://matplotlib.org/). However, other plotting libraries can be considered if they offer better functionality for the specific data.
The freelancer should ensure the code is well-documented and easy to understand.
I am open to discussing additional features, such as the ability to choose different chart types or customize the visualization output.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-361" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Plot .csv files in Browser Window"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 946px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-362" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">I am looking to develop a sophisticated user interface for a machine learning-based tool that complements the research outlined in my thesis. The primary function of this tool is to analyze user data to enhance performance through tailored insights and adaptive feedback mechanisms. The interface will be developed using Python with the tkinter library, ensuring ease of use and effective interaction between users and the analytical backend.

Project Objectives:

The user interface needs to accurately represent and implement the methodologies and findings of my thesis research, which focuses on leveraging machine learning to optimize user engagement and performance metrics.

Core Requirements:

User Demographic Inputs: Include input fields to collect essential demographic data such as age and gender to personalize the analysis and outputs based on user characteristics.

Expanded Engagement Metrics: Monitor and analyze a variety of engagement indicators including resource utilization, participation metrics, and activity levels. Enhancements to include additional metrics such as quiz outcomes and submission timelines are critical for comprehensive engagement analysis.

Personalized Recommendations: The system should provide actionable advice and tailored suggestions based on individual performance assessments and engagement patterns. Examples include prompts to engage more with specific types of content or resources.

Resource Recommendations Based on Analysis: Automatically suggest educational resources tailored to the user’s specific needs and identified areas for improvement, linking these resources directly within the platform.

Performance Impact Insights: Deliver clear explanations on how each engagement metric influences overall performance, supported by empirical data and the analytical studies from the thesis.

Real-time Feedback: Enable a feature that provides users with instant feedback on their activities, helping them understand the immediate effect of their actions according to the machine learning analysis.

Advanced Features:

Adaptive Learning Paths: Use the findings from the thesis to adjust learning paths dynamically based on the machine learning analysis of ongoing user performance and engagement data.

Interactive Data Visualization: Implement interactive charts and graphs that allow users to visualize their progress and engagement in real-time, comparing it against predefined benchmarks or personalized goals.

Community Engagement Tools: Incorporate social features that enable users to connect and form communities with peers who have similar learning patterns or interests.

Gamification Elements: Integrate game-like elements such as badges, points, or achievement levels to motivate users and promote frequent interactions with the tool.

Accessibility Features: Design the interface to be fully accessible, including text-to-speech functions, high-contrast modes, and keyboard navigability.

Security and Privacy Protections: Enforce advanced security measures to ensure all user data is securely stored and processed, in compliance with applicable privacy regulations.

Technical Requirements:

Responsive Design: Guarantee a seamless experience across all device types, enabling users to interact with the platform effectively whether on desktops, tablets, or mobile phones.

Data Collection and Analysis: Implement a robust backend system capable of collecting and analyzing user data in real-time, necessary to support the sophisticated features proposed.

Extensibility: Construct the system with flexible and modular components, making it easy to update and incorporate additional functionalities as needed.

User Feedback Mechanism: Provide avenues for users to give feedback on the system, using their insights to continually refine and enhance the interface and its features.

Project Goal:

This project aims to create a highly adaptive, interactive, and engaging user interface that effectively translates the research from my thesis into practical, data-driven tools for enhancing user performance. This interface will not only reflect the theoretical framework and empirical findings of my research but also provide a practical application to assist users in maximizing their interactive productivity and engagement.

      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 396px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-363" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Job Description:

We are seeking a Data Science Engineer with expertise in artificial intelligence and video analytics to develop a prototype system. The project aims to analyze zoo footage to enhance animal welfare and ensure park security using AI-driven recognition techniques. The selected candidate will work with publicly available YouTube videos to develop a system that can accurately identify behaviors indicative of animal wellbeing and potential security breaches.

Responsibilities:

Collect and preprocess video data from YouTube, focusing on typical zoo environments and animal behaviors.
Develop and train a machine learning model capable of recognizing specified animal behaviors and safety incidents.
Integrate the AI model into a simple application that processes video in real-time and analyzes the footage.
Perform prototype testing to assess accuracy and effectiveness, making iterative improvements based on feedback.
Provide comprehensive documentation and a user manual for the prototype.
Required Skills:

Proven experience in AI, machine learning, and video analytics.
Proficient with Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Strong background in video processing and algorithm development.
Creative problem-solving skills and excellent analytical abilities.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
Project Deliverables:

A working AI video analytics prototype that meets project goals.
Complete source code and all associated developmental materials.
Detailed technical documentation and an operational user manual.


Application Instructions:
Interested candidates should apply with a portfolio that includes similar projects in video analytics and machine learning. Please also provide a brief outline of your approach to this project and any preliminary ideas you have to ensure the effectiveness of the prototype.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-363" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Wildlife Analysis of Zoo Footage to Identify AI Recognition on Animal Wellbeing and Park Security"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="display: none;">

Objectives:

Develop a cross-platform mobile app that allows users to upload pet photos and apply AI-driven transformations to create humorous pet portraits. The customer will then be able to order custom prints or products with their design via our POD website.

Integrate advanced AI image processing technologies to identify pets in photos and apply various artistic and funny styles.

Responsibilities:

Design and build a high-quality mobile application using React Native or Flutter.
Integrate AI models for image recognition and transformation, utilizing platforms such as Google Cloud Vision or Amazon Rekognition.
Implement core features including photo upload, AI transformation preview, style selection, and e-commerce capabilities for ordering prints.
Work collaboratively with a UX/UI designer to ensure the application is visually appealing and easy to navigate.
Conduct thorough testing to ensure app stability, security, and performance.
Provide post-launch support and iterative updates based on user feedback.
Requirements:

Proven experience in mobile app development with a portfolio of released applications on the Android and iOS markets.
Strong knowledge of cross-platform development frameworks, preferably React Native or Flutter.
Experience with AI technologies, particularly in image processing and machine learning.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a team environment.
Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Project Duration:

Expected to last 3-6 months with potential for ongoing maintenance and future updates.
Budget:

Open to proposals. Please provide a detailed quote with your application.
To Apply:

Submit a proposal outlining your experience, a brief plan for the project, and examples of previous work, especially any similar apps or AI integration projects.
Include references or client testimonials if available.

Transcribe an mp3 file into an XML document with Assembly AI API functions containing (a) Transcription (a) Meeting Summary, (b) Chapter Gist, Headline and Summary, (c) Speaker Diarization, (d) Entity detection (person_name), and (e) Agenda Items (LeMUR Model Q&amp;A).
For an Assembly AI API experienced developer this is a simple meeting transcription using standard API functions in a commercial application. Assembly AI https://www.assemblyai.com/

BACKGROUND
We are an Australian company (Australian Timezone AEST) with a meeting management web app developed and supported by an EU dev team. Although a good team they have no AI experience, so we require external SW dev for our team to reintegrate.

PROJECT SCOPE/DELIVERABLES
1.	Identify any issues and questions you may have.
2.	Project has two logical components to be coded using agreed language: Node.js (preferred), Python, or Javascript:
(a)	Assembly AI transcription of supplied mp3 file
(b)	XML file output to a local or cloud folder
3.	This application requires no UI, you will be provided a number of mp3 URL file paths
4.	The system shall use the Assembly AI API and the mp3 audio file
5.	The system shall use the specific Assembly AI API functions to perform each of the following:
(a)	Speech Recognition (full text transcript) as the basis for below features.
(b)	Meeting Summary (summary_model: “conversational”, summary_type: “paragraph)
(c)	Chapter Gist, Headline, Summary, start and end Timestamps
(d)	Speaker Diarization, store all API outputs
(e)	Entity detection of “person_name”, stored and matched to speaker diarization name (if possible)
(f)	Agenda Items (use Assembly AI LeMUR Model).
6.	Output items 5 (a)-(f) into an XML document to local file location.
7.	Source Code placed into Github for reintegration to our code base.
8.	A meeting with our developers to answer any questions
9.	Completion dependent on your provided solution and UAT pass with reasonable accuracy based on a standard mp3 file.

OUR APPLICATION
Our third-party developed web application performs integrated meeting booking and management of minutes and actions with API integrations to Google Meet, MS365 Graph API, and Amazon email.
- React &amp; Node.JS with a Postgres SQL Database
- GitHub code repository
- AWS EC2 instance

ESTIMATED TIMELINE
Max 4 weeks elapsed time, we are negotiable on cost if you can justify it in detail.

INTERACTION WITH OUR TEAM
Initial meeting, independent work, progress updates by email report and meeting.

FUTURE WORK POTENTIAL
Future AI development work.

OUR EXPERIENCE
40 years of software development expertise across many tech startups.

YOUR EXPERIENCE
A professional and experienced Assembly AI developer (preferred) or an expert at API integration with AI who can get the job done efficiently. Your experience will include excellent communication and documentation skills, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, React, CSS, HTML.

HIGHLY REGARDED
Previous Assembly AI API integration where you can provide examples and answer our video interview questions.

The SIEM should have a combination of security information management (SIM) and security event management (SEM). It alerts us about potential attacks on our network we deploy the agent or probe on, information security incidents, or even compliance issues. This SIEM solution should offer real-time monitoring and analysis of events by strengthening threat detection and security incident management through pulling live data and historical security event data. SIEM’s core functioning includes a range of tracking, logging, collection, and management of security data for compliance or auditing purposes, including operational capabilities such as reporting, data aggregation, security monitoring, and user activity monitoring.

6. Stay updated with changes in the Instagram API and adapt the system accordingly to maintain functionality.
7. Collaborate with the frontend development team to ensure smooth integration and user experience.
8. Troubleshoot and resolve any issues or bugs that may arise during development and deployment.

Requirements:
1. Proven experience in developing Instagram bots or similar automation systems.
2. In-depth knowledge of the Instagram API and its various endpoints.
3. Proficiency in Python programming language, particularly with the Instabot Python library.
4. Experience in implementing authentication mechanisms to prevent account suspension or bans.
5. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently.
6. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
7. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and deliver high-quality results within tight deadlines.
8. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (preferred).

Additional Information:
This is a remote position with the possibility of occasional meetings or team gatherings.
Flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate different time zones.
The selected candidate will be expected to adhere to ethical standards and comply with Instagram's terms of service and usage policies.
Prior experience with Instagram bot development and familiarity with Instagram's API rate limits will be considered a strong advantage.
Knowledge and experience with implementing a single-login mechanism to enhance user experience and prevent account bans are highly desirable.

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Developer to create a sophisticated chatbot that functions as an interactive tutor for a range of educational courses. The chatbot should be capable of providing real-time feedback on assignments and case studies completed by students. Our current Learning Management System (LMS) is developed using Flutter and Firebase, and the chatbot should integrate seamlessly with this existing system.

Responsibilities:

Design and develop an AI-powered chatbot that can answer questions related to course content and provide explanations.
Integrate the chatbot with our LMS developed in Flutter and backed by Firebase for seamless user interaction.
Implement natural language processing (NLP) capabilities to ensure the chatbot understands and responds accurately to student queries.
Program the chatbot to assess student assignments and case studies, providing instant feedback and scoring.
Collaborate with educational experts to align chatbot responses with curriculum goals.
Continuously test, refine, and update the chatbot based on user feedback and performance data.

Requirements:
Strong programming skills in Python, and familiarity with AI development frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience with Flutter and Firebase for app development and data management.

Project Deliverables:

A fully functional AI chatbot integrated into our LMS.
Documentation outlining the chatbot’s design, functionalities, and integration process.

The initial development phase is expected to3-4 weeks, with potential for ongoing work based on project needs and performance.

      </span></span> <!----></small> <!----></div> <div class="my-4x"><div data-ev-sublocation="!line_clamp" class="air3-line-clamp-wrapper text-body break job-description" data-test="job-description-line-clamp" style="--lines: 3; --line-clamp-expanded-height: 726px; --line-clamp-line-height: 22px;"><!----> <div id="air3-line-clamp-411" tabindex="-1" class="air3-line-clamp is-clamped"><span data-test="job-description-text">Project Overview
The goal of this project is to develop a content search and question-answering system (AI Assistant)  that can retrieve relevant information from PDF documents and web pages based on semantic matching and exact lexical/keyword matching. The system should be capable of handling natural language queries related to arc welding, including questions about potential hazards, precautions, and first aid solutions. Additionally, it should support e-commerce-style semantic search for retrieving relevant documents or PDF files based on user-provided keywords.

Functional Requirements
Data Ingestion
The system should be able to ingest and process PDF documents and scraped web pages related to welding.
It should extract text content from these sources and store it in a structured format for indexing and retrieval.
Semantic Search

The system should support semantic search, allowing users to enter natural language queries related to arc welding.
It should identify the intent and context of the query and retrieve relevant information from the ingested data sources based on meaning and semantic similarity.
Example queries: "What are the potential hazards in arc welding?", "What precautions should be taken while welding?", "What are the first aid solutions when arc welding?"
Exact Lexical/Keyword Matching
In addition to semantic search, the system should support exact lexical/keyword matching.
It should be able to identify and match specific alphanumeric patterns, such as CAS Numbers and other relevant identifiers mentioned on Page 2 of the provided pdf.
Question-Answering (Q&amp;A) Interface
The system should provide a user-friendly Q&amp;A interface, allowing users to interact with the system through natural language queries.
The interface should display relevant information retrieved from the ingested data sources, along with appropriate context and citations.
E-commerce-style Semantic Search
The system should support e-commerce-style semantic search, allowing users to enter keywords or phrases related to welding.
It should retrieve and display relevant PDF documents (url to pdf) or web pages (url to web [ages) based on the user's input.
AWS Hosting and Demo
The solution should be hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) for demonstration purposes.
A demo URL should be provided, allowing stakeholders and users to access and test the system.
Non-Functional Requirements

Scalability: The system should be designed to handle large volumes of data and support concurrent user requests without significant performance degradation.
Maintainability: The codebase should follow best practices for maintainability, including modular design, clear documentation, and adherence to coding standards.
Security: Appropriate security measures should be implemented to protect the system and user data from unauthorized access or malicious attacks.
User Experience: The user interface should be intuitive, responsive, and provide a seamless experience for users interacting with the system.
Deliverables

Functional prototype of the content search and question-answering system, hosted on AWS.
Demo URL for stakeholders and users to access and test the system.
Comprehensive documentation, including installation instructions, API documentation and a user guide.
Source code repository with version control.
Hosting charges on AWS will be paid extra.</span></div> <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="air3-line-clamp-411" type="button" data-ev-label="line_clamp_toggle" data-ev-open="false" class="air3-btn-link-secondary"><!----> <span><span>more</span> <span class="sr-only"> about "Content Search (Vector based scemantic search and RAG based AI assistant)"</span></span></button></div></div> <div class="mt-4x"><div data-test="token-container"><div role="group" data-ev-sublocation="!token_container" class="air3-token-container"><!----> <button data-test="token-skip-link" type="button" data-ev-label="token_skip_link" class="air3-token-skip sr-only" style="">

We are seeking a skilled Developer to create two advanced automation bots designed to enhance our digital marketing and recruitment efforts. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing secure, efficient software solutions with experience in UI design, automation, and cybersecurity.

Key Responsibilities:

Google Ads Penetration Testing Bot:

Develop a bot to conduct penetration testing on Google Ads setups to ensure robust security and to identify vulnerabilities.
Implement automated scripts that simulate various security breach attempts to assess the resilience of Google Ads configurations.
Design and develop a user-friendly interface for managing the bot and reviewing penetration testing reports.
Deploy the bot and ensure its continuous operation with regular updates and maintenance.
LinkedIn Automation Bot:

Develop a bot to automate the process of sending connection requests and applying for jobs on LinkedIn.
Ensure the bot complies with LinkedIn’s terms of service and automation rules to avoid penalties.
Create a sophisticated UI that allows users to customize job search criteria, message templates, and track application statuses.

This project requires meticulous work to create accurate polygon annotations for various objects within the images.

- Annotate images using polygon annotation tools with precision and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:
Prior experience working with large image datasets.

https://1drv.ms/f/s!AqmCPsDcm7ajpsMBtwJ8aTJKwfMf1Q?e=0Th2bR

all_orders.csv: Includes all placed orders, noting which have been filled and which have been cancelled, including those cancelled due to simultaneous executions.
filled_orders.csv: Contains details of all filled orders along with the profit (pnl) generated from each.
ob_best_ts.csv: Provides public market data about the Bitcoin order book, detailing the best bid and ask prices.



Key Analyses to be Conducted:

1. Comprehensive Order Execution Analysis:

Analyze the overall execution rates, focusing on why orders are filled or cancelled. Evaluate how market conditions at the time of order placement influence these outcomes.



2. Profitability Analysis of Filled Orders:

Examine the profit and loss data from filled orders to identify patterns and factors that contribute to higher profitability. Assess the impact of order timing, size, and market conditions on profitability.


3. Order Book Dynamics Correlation:

Explore correlations between the order book data (best bid and ask prices) and the execution success of orders. Determine if specific order book conditions are predictive of higher fill rates and profitability.



4. Strategic Order Placement Analysis:

Investigate the bid-ask spread at the time of order placement versus execution. Use visualizations, such as histograms, to analyze spread impact on order performance and identify optimal conditions for order placement.



5. Strategy Backtesting and Optimization:

Utilize backtesting frameworks to simulate various trading strategies using historical data. Develop strategies that align with findings from the data to enhance profitability and fill rates. Demonstrate these strategies through a well-documented Jupyter notebook.



Candidate Requirements:

Proficiency in Python and familiarity with data analysis libraries (e.g., pandas, numpy) and visualization tools (e.g., matplotlib, seaborn).
Experience with financial market analysis, particularly in cryptocurrencies.
Ability to synthesize complex datasets into actionable strategies and clear visualizations.
Proven track record of delivering data-driven insights and reports.
